LanguageData.BM_DragOrderTip: Hold and drag to change build order
LanguageData.BM_TooManyTip: 5 or more of the same building are unbuilt; handle some of them before jumping.
LanguageData.BM_ProtectHint: While protected, lower priorities never take materials reserved for the top priority. Once the window expires, half of the reserve opens to lower priorities and the other half stays reserved. 0 = no protection.
LanguageData.BM_AgeHint: If an order gets no materials for this long, its scheduling rank is raised to just below the top priority so it passes everything else in the queue. The top priority itself is unaffected. 0 = aging off.
LanguageData.BM_DiagHint: This table answers "why is this order not moving?". Read-only: nothing you do here changes any scheduling decision.
LanguageData.BM_DiagBestIncomplete: Scan incomplete (candidate cap reached), no conclusion this round
LanguageData.BM_DiagIdleReason: Buildable — no one assigned right now
LanguageData.BM_CellNotCountedTip: Not counted for this group yet
LanguageData.BM_CellNoShortageTip: No material shortage in this group
LanguageData.BM_LevelOpenHint1: Drag the two handles to set the allowed construction level for this type.
LanguageData.BM_LevelOpenHint2: Click Close to go back to the summary.
LanguageData.BM_SchedHint: These settings are configured once and rarely touched, so they live here instead of the main pane.
LanguageData.BM_WorkersBtnTip:
Only pawns on this list may finish this type; others can still deliver materials for ordinary blueprints.
Stacks with the level range: permission, level and this list must all pass.
A "reinstall" blueprint is hauled and installed by the same job, so pawns off the list will not even haul it.
Covers finishing buildings and reinstalling only; removing floors, removing foundations and smoothing walls ignore this list.
LanguageData.BM_WorkersClearTip: Clearing restores "Any": every permitted pawn within the level range may finish it.
LanguageData.BM_WorkersLevelOut: level outside {0}~{1} (building only; installing ignores it)
LanguageData.BM_WorkersEmptyTip: No list set; anyone can do it.
LanguageData.BM_PanePickHint: Click any row to see its details here.
LanguageData.BM_DiagFormula: How the available amount is computed:
LanguageData.RF_BlockedThick: Blocked {0} of {1}: the thick roof above will collapse ({2} cells), and thick roof cannot be removed. Right-click to force {0} to ignore this.
LanguageData.RF_BlockedUnremovable: Blocked {0} of {1}: the roof above will collapse ({2} cells), and that roof cannot be removed. Right-click to force {0} to ignore this.
LanguageData.RF_BlockedUnreachable: Blocked {0} of {1}: the roof above will collapse, but colonists cannot reach those roof cells ({2}). Open a path first, or right-click to force {0}.
LanguageData.RF_PausedThick: Paused {0} of {1}: {2} roof cells are marked for removal, but thick roof above will still collapse and cannot be removed. After clearing the normal roof, right-click to force {0} if you want to continue.
LanguageData.RF_PausedRoofFirst: Paused {0} of {1}: remove the {2} roof cells above first (already marked as a "remove roof" area); work will resume automatically afterwards. Cancel the {0} order if you do not want to remove the roof.
LanguageData.RF_WarningMessage: Warning: removing {0} will cause a thick roof collapse ({1} cells); thick roof cannot be removed.
LanguageData.RF_AlertExplanation: Removing the following targets will leave the thick roof above unsupported and cause it to collapse; thick roof cannot be removed with "Remove roof".\n\nClick a target below to jump to its position.
LanguageData.BM_RowHeightTip: Pixels, {0}-{1}, default {2}. Values outside the range are clamped; non-numeric or empty input keeps the current value. Only affects the type-group table on the Construction tab.
